:::note[About this page]
This page is an unofficial guide to S1000D® Issue 7, written in this project's own words. It is based on the S1000D distribution dated 2026-07-16. This is a personal project and is not affiliated with ASD ([Specification files and trademarks](/s1000d-stack/guide/license/)). The formal definition is in Chap 3.9.5.1 of the S1000D specification and in the [S1000D Issue 7 data dictionary](https://users.s1000d.org/S1000D_DD_7/Files/attributes/inWork.xml).
:::

`inWork` is the attribute that gives the in-work number of a data module. Together with [`issueNumber`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/issue-number/), it identifies an issue.

## Elements that carry it

In the 33 XML schemas of Issue 7, 2 elements carry this attribute.

| Element | Schemas | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `issueInfo` | 28 | Required |
| `targetDmIssueInfo` | 1 | Required |

## Allowed values

The allowed values are decided by the XML schema. The default BREX (Business Rules Exchange) has no rule that lists the values of this attribute.

| Defined by | Content |
| --- | --- |
| XML schema | The type is `inWorkAttType` (based on `xs:nonNegativeInteger`). The pattern is `\d{2}` |

## Meaning of the values

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `00` | A released issue |
| `01` to `99` | An in-work issue. The first value is `01`, and it is raised each time the unreleased data module is changed |

## In this stack

| Operation | Tool |
| --- | --- |
| Read | [`list_data_modules`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/reader/list-data-modules/) and [`read_data_module`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/reader/read-data-module/). The value is in `issueInfo` |
| Start an in-work issue | [`start_revision`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/writer/start-revision/). It sets `inWork` to `01` and writes a new file. The file of the released issue is not changed |
| Protect a released issue | [`edit_data_module`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/writer/edit-data-module/) edits an issue whose `inWork` is `00` only when `allowReleasedIssue: true` is passed. An edit with `marking` is refused even with this value |

This stack does not yet have an operation that releases an issue (setting `inWork` back to `00` and raising `issueNumber`).
